text_excerpt: Home - The Collaborative Member Login Discovery Call Menu By Dr. Heather Hirsch Modern Solutions for Menopause Expertly led concierge care delivering clarity, confidence, and results at midlife Schedule a Discovery Call Generational health, built at midlife. Our clinicians support longevity practices that optimize your menopause journey. “I feel understood and truly listened to! After being on HRT for over a year, I feel like I found the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow!” ERICA Midlife Weight Gain We take a science driven, compassionate approach to midlife weight changes with personalized nutrition, individualized metabolic and hormone plans, sustainable habits and physician guided GLP-1 support for lasting health. Thyroid Support We provide whole-person, evidence-based thyroid care that aligns with menopause support, using comprehensive labs, targeted treatment, and integrated HRT guidance to improve energy, mood, metabolism, and long-term hormonal balance in midlife. Cancer Care We offer integrative menopause and survivorship care with cancer-sensitive hormone management, individualized symptom support, non-hormonal and approved hormonal options, and coordinated plans with oncology teams to restore comfort, strength, metabolism, and long-term wellbeing. How It Works 1 Request a Discovery Call With Our Concierge Team 2 Become an annual member & get matched with your expert clinician 3 Get comprehensive, personalized menopause care on your schedule Schedule a Discovery Call Why We’re Different Discover Dr. Hirsch’s Signature “Hormone Stacking” Method Our trademark approach to hormone therapy Layering the right forms and doses of estrogen, progesterone, and testosterone to optimize symptom relief safely and effectively. Precision Personalization Hormone stacking introduces each hormone thoughtfully and adjusts based on your body’s response, creating a truly individualized, precision HRT plan. Expert Guidance A core principle is ensuring you know what each hormone is doing individually in your body, so therapy works for you and not against you. This clarity helps tailor care and minimize unnecessary side effects. Balance for Optimal Outcomes The method emphasizes achieving balanced hormone levels rather than one-size-fits-all dosing. Taking it step by step allows clinicians to optimize symptom relief while minimizing side effects.
